outOfScope: Global scheduler, role registry or organization workflow graph.
Exactly-once event transport or transactional outbox as a correctness prerequisite.
Deployment, AcceptanceSnapshot or Product QA semantics.
Execution-policy or strategy selection inside the activation boundary.
constraints: Event or queue delivery is not lifecycle, claim or execution authority.
Activation is not strategy selection and is not obligation creation.
Queue, cursor and local backoff state are disposable and reconstructable from canonical work state.
A stale queued hint cannot resurrect invalidated work.
Frontend and Backend independence is governed by exact semantic dependencies, not global development stages.
A durable runtime such as Restate may host activation mechanics but cannot become organizational source of truth or hidden scheduler.
invariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
architectureDecisions: Activation is domain-local level-triggered reconciliation over exact projectId/workId/owningDomain; it is not scheduling.
Events/watch/poll are latency hints only; canonical listEligible({owningDomain}) scan is the restart/recovery source.
Claim/release and post-release BB-052 currentness gate execution; stale work is fenced before dispatch.
Activation never creates obligations or selects ExecutionStrategy; DomainExecutionController policy remains HOW authority.
BB-052 must be DONE before BB-053 WORKER execution; research may converge before that dependency completes.
BACKEND and FRONTEND use separate domain hosts/controllers/runtime adapters with no implicit stage barrier.
Frontend is a first-class domain contract, not a Backend conversation/stage continuation.
Activation observations are telemetry only, never lifecycle/claim/strategy/publication authority.
implementationSlices: D1 — Exact activation subject [AC-2, AC-3, INV-1, INV-3]: domain-activation.js defines DomainActivationKey={projectId,workId,owningDomain} and a domain-bound reconcile(key). reconcile re-reads the exact current Board/WorkContract, rejects wrong-domain or non-actionable/stale subjects as NOOP, and never accepts role, stage, policyRef, strategyRef or runtime adapter from a trigger.

D2 — Autonomous domain host [AC-1, AC-6, AC-7, INV-2, INV-6, INV-7]: domain-activation-host.js implements activationHostContract exactly. start() immediately calls discovery.listEligible({owningDomain}); scanOnce() independently reconcile()s every exact eligible subject with Promise.allSettled; then the same host arms its next scan. notify(key) only invokes the same reconcile early. BACKEND and FRONTEND hosts own separate loop/timer/error state, so one rejected scan/dispatch cannot cancel or gate the other. No next-role/domain dispatcher exists.

D3 — Authorized execution admission [AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, INV-4, INV-5, INV-8]: after activation pre-check, use existing organization claim/release with the host's trusted domain principal; re-read exact BB-052 obligation/currentness after release; on drift invalidate/fence that claim and return NOOP. On success call the already-bound DomainExecutionController only with {itemId,claimGeneration,receiptRef}; existing policy keyed by owningDomain+workloadType remains sole strategy authority.

D4 — Backend domain runtime [AC-5, AC-6, INV-4, INV-7]: backend-execution-strategy.js implements the existing runtimeAdapter dispatch/recover boundary over current Backend prepare/run/recover primitives. It produces Backend-owned result/evidence only. composition.js/runBackendThenQaObjective and durable-backend-qa are explicitly not activation or Backend strategy because they encode a serial cross-domain handoff.

D5 — First-class Frontend domain runtime [AC-5, AC-6, INV-6, INV-7]: frontend-contracts/worker/application/completion implement domainAutonomyContract.frontend exactly from the bound OrganizationWorkContract: order from contract fields, context from exact requiredArtifactRefs, result mapped to runtimeAdapter outputs/evidence, completion from acceptanceRefs/evidence, recovery from the same attempt binding. No Backend session/stage/completion field is an input.

D6 — Independent composition + overlap proof [AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, INV-6, INV-7]: domain-runtime-composition constructs and starts separate BACKEND and FRONTEND host/controller/execution-controller/runtime-adapter graphs. domain-host-autonomy.test proves both hosts continue scans independently and no manual dispatcher API exists. fe-be-parallel.test persists unrelated FE/BE work, starts both hosts, blocks each adapter on its own barrier, and before either barrier is released requires both dispatchStarted plus distinct workContractRef, executionPolicyRef, executionStrategyRef, executionAttemptId and runtimeInvocationKey; then one adapter is failed while the other must still reach its own current completion.

D7 — Restart, duplicate and invalidation convergence [AC-1, AC-2, AC-4, AC-8, INV-2, INV-8]: activation-recovery.test recreates a host with no hint/cursor state and proves immediate canonical scan rediscovers persisted work; duplicate notify+scan converge through existing claim/attempt currentness. partial-invalidation.test supersedes one exact obligation between pre-check and execution entry and proves only that subject is fenced/NOOP while unrelated domain work remains discoverable/executable.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Persisted actionable work is rediscovered and processed after controller restart even when its original notification was lost.
evidenceRequired: Fresh host with no hint/timer state immediately scans listEligible(domain) and enters claim/execution without an event.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Concurrent duplicate hints for one work item converge to one current claim/execution path.
evidenceRequired: Concurrent notify+scan for one exact key converge to one current claim/attempt; duplicate becomes NOOP/replay.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A wrong-domain activation attempt cannot claim or execute the work.
evidenceRequired: Wrong-domain principal/controller is rejected before executable claim or execution entry.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Obligation supersession between activation pre-check and execution entry prevents execution through the post-release currentness recheck.
evidenceRequired: Supersede the exact obligation after pre-check; post-release recheck fences claim and prevents dispatch.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Frontend and Backend work can progress concurrently and independently under their own domain execution strategies.
evidenceRequired: Frontend contract derives only from its WorkContract and reads no Backend state.
Both domain adapters reach dispatchStarted before either barrier releases, with distinct policy/strategy/attempt/runtime invocation identities.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An outage in one domain leaves unrelated work in another domain actionable and able to progress.
evidenceRequired: Force BACKEND host/adapter failure; FRONTEND independently rescans, claims, dispatches and completes without Backend host/attempt state.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Removing a manual next-role dispatcher does not stop progress for persisted actionable work.
evidenceRequired: No nextRole/nextDomain/stage API exists; with no event, startup/periodic domain scans still discover and reconcile persisted work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Partial upstream invalidation suppresses only affected activation subjects while unrelated domain work remains actionable.
evidenceRequired: Invalidate one exact subject; only it becomes NOOP/fenced while unrelated domain work executes.

Activation cannot supply strategy; DomainExecutionController policy remains required.
Frontend is blocked only by explicit semantic dependencies, not Backend stage state.

livingDocs.statement: The delivered Integration D Living Docs accurately describe domain-local level-triggered activation, claim/execution admission, FE/BE independent domain strategies, recovery and non-authoritative wake-up hints.

autonomyContract.host: One DomainActivationHost per owningDomain. start() immediately calls createOrganizationWorkDiscovery(...).listEligible({owningDomain}); scanOnce() derives exact {projectId,workId,owningDomain} keys and Promise.allSettled(reconcile(key)) for every eligible subject, then arms that host's next scan. notify(key) is latency-only. Scan order has no priority/authority meaning.
autonomyContract.isolation: BACKEND and FRONTEND hosts have separate principal/controller/execution-controller/runtimeAdapter and loop/timer/error state. Composition starts both without awaiting either. A rejected scan/reconcile/dispatch is local to that host and cannot cancel or gate its sibling.
autonomyContract.admission: reconcile re-reads exact work and domain; claim/release uses the host's trusted principal; exact BB-052 currentness is rechecked after release; drift fences the claim. Activation calls execution with {itemId,claimGeneration,receiptRef} only; owningDomain+workloadType policy remains sole strategy authority.
autonomyContract.backend: BACKEND runtimeAdapter wraps existing Backend prepare/run/recover only; serial Backend→QA composition is not reused.
autonomyContract.frontend: FrontendWorkOrder derives {workContractRef,projectId,itemId,summary,requiredArtifactRefs,expectedArtifactKind,expectedOutputRefs,acceptanceRefs} from OrganizationWorkContract. FrontendContext resolves only requiredArtifactRefs. FrontendWorkResult maps APPLIED|BLOCKED|FAILED plus outputs/evidence to runtimeAdapter result. Completion evaluates acceptanceRefs/evidence; recovery reuses the same attempt binding. No Backend stage/session/completion input exists.
autonomyContract.proof: Persist unrelated BACKEND+FRONTEND work with distinct active policy/strategy descriptors; start both hosts; each adapter emits dispatchStarted and waits on its own barrier. Before either release, assert both started and distinct workContractRef/policyRef/strategyRef/attemptId/runtimeInvocationKey. Fail one adapter and require the other to complete independently.
autonomyContract.noDispatcher: No nextRole/nextDomain/stage-transition API. Persisted work progresses from each domain host's startup/periodic canonical scan even with no notify/event; restart needs no queue/cursor.
